subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should block-streaming paragraph boundaries be preserved with in-band text only, explicit boundary metadata through delivery, or an accepted partial repair for common in-budget cases?
rationale: The remaining exact-boundary case cannot be resolved by this text-only shape without choosing between maxChars enforcement, coalesced-seam correctness, and a broader delivery contract.

options.title: Require a complete shared fix
options.body: Choose this PR, the sibling PR, or a replacement only after the near-maxChars separator case is preserved without doubled coalesced seams.

options.title: Adopt boundary metadata
options.body: Ask the implementation to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer instead of overloading payload text.

options.title: Accept partial text repair
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land the common-case fix while leaving the exact-boundary limitation documented on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Choose this PR, the sibling PR, or a replacement only after the near-maxChars separator case is preserved without doubled coalesced seams.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across streaming docs, block coalescing, and chunking hardening, making it the best available owner for the boundary-contract choice.
